title: Just as You Feared — Life in Zohran Mamdani’s New York. “Breakfast...
content: Just as You Feared — Life in Zohran Mamdani’s New York. “Breakfast is sugar-free pea fibre from the state-run ZohranMart. I wish that I could give my son something better — it’s his birthday. But he doesn’t mind. School has turned him very woke.”
author: Jason Kottke
